runs.result: re-applied after an OpenSync restart, with two faults found and fixed
events: 21:40:14 first attempt: restart.sh on pod-6; the agent took the pod's restart for another manager's change and held it. AWLAN_Node comes from the database template (conf.db.bck) and keeps its UUID across starts. Fix: a start is identified by the Wifi_Radio_Config row UUIDs, which the start scripts create anew
21:51:25 restart.sh on pod-6; 21:52:59 switched again on the new start, applied 21:53:15.6 (16 s)

but the switch ran alongside the controller's M2 that re-creates the fronthaul: the create's reply was lost when the path moved (INDETERMINATE, then TIMED_OUT), later M2s were rejected BUSY, and the pod served no BSS. Fixes: the switch waits until the fronthaul is served and no fronthaul operation is active; a provisioned agent whose pod serves no BSS for 60 s asks for M2 again (fresh M1)
